verdict.rationale: Offline email is a fair question for an email client like Missive, so the axis applies. The pack never documents offline reading, searching or composing, or a queue that syncs changes on reconnect. Local attachment downloads and community remarks that the desktop app feels snappy are adjacent behaviours, not an offline mode.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
